matrix.reason: GenerateRPCFromProto recursively parses local proto imports, preserves qualified RPC method references, and resolves imported go_package aliases for generated method signatures.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by preserving local import merge evidence and treating lost imported DTO generation as a supported-row regression.

matrix.reason: GenerateRPCFromProto can split multiple services into service-specific output directories when Multiple is enabled.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by preserving service-specific generated output directories and blocking release if multi-service output disappears.

matrix.surface: server, client, and bidirectional streaming descriptors
matrix.reason: Generated service descriptors expose stream modes and stream metadata for all three gRPC streaming forms.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by preserving stream descriptor generation and treating lost stream mode metadata as a breaking candidate.

matrix.reason: Common google.protobuf well-known types are mapped to stable Go shapes such as time.Time, time.Duration, struct{}, map[string]any, []any, any, and []string.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by preserving WKT mapping evidence and treating lost WKT type generation as a supported-row regression.

matrix.reason: Generated clients include unary wrappers and stream-opening helpers when client generation is enabled.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by preserving generated client wrappers or documenting NoClient as an explicit compatibility downgrade.

matrix.reason: The gozero-compatible new rpc profile generates protobuf stubs, config, service context, logic, server, typed client, discovery wiring, and a runnable main package.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by retaining the previous scaffold profile and blocking release when the generated module or unary smoke test no longer passes.

matrix.surface: real go-zero zRPC and gofly runtime interoperability
matrix.reason: An isolated nested module starts each framework server and calls an explicit unary Echo data-plane method through the other framework client, while also checking the standard health contract.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback interoperability claims and keep both framework endpoints routable if either real cross-framework direction stops passing.

matrix.surface: real go-zero zRPC and gofly streaming runtime interoperability
matrix.reason: The isolated interoperability module executes all three standard gRPC streaming modes through real zRPC and gofly server and client wrappers in both directions.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Keep streaming traffic on the previously validated RPC runtime and remove streaming interoperability claims if any direction or lifecycle scenario regresses.

matrix.reason: Generated clients read the native zRPC key-per-instance etcd layout, react to endpoint updates, reuse identical cluster connections, and close owned resolver resources without adding go-zero to the root module; the interoperability fixture also resolves and invokes a real go-zero server registered by its native Publisher.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Keep explicit endpoints or an injected discovery resolver available and remove automatic zRPC etcd compatibility claims if raw endpoint decoding or lifecycle ownership regresses.

matrix.reason: Generated servers can explicitly publish the native zRPC key-per-instance raw endpoint layout, which a real go-zero zRPC client resolves through Etcd before invoking the gofly service; together with the reverse go-zero Publisher to gofly resolver call, this proves bidirectional discovery interoperability and lease-owned removal on shutdown without replacing gofly's native registry format.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Remove the top-level generated Etcd block and use native gofly discovery if lease ownership, raw endpoint publication, or go-zero client discovery regresses.

matrix.surface: native gRPC discovery, lifecycle, client defaults, and balancing
matrix.reason: The native gRPC runtime now provides safe client credentials, default observability, backend-neutral discovery registration and resolution, health transitions, and selectable balancers.
matrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by keeping direct gRPC targets available and treating any discovery, health, credentials, or balancing regression as a release blocker.

releaseRules.supportedRegression: Any supported row that loses generated evidence blocks release.
releaseRules.degradedClaim: Degraded rows may not be described as full goctl or zRPC parity in docs or release notes.
releaseRules.unsupportedPromotion: Promotion from degraded to supported requires fixture coverage, generated output evidence, and release gate updates.
